brief: The canvas displays an intricate, abstract network of dark cables forming a complex, dense tangle. Along these lines move luminous, highly defined data streams that emit from a central point and propagate outward. These streams travel in distinct, visible waves, exhibiting a rhythmic pulse as they spread. When the waves encounter a major junction, they momentarily brighten and visibly split, forming secondary, branching streams that dissipate into the outer network, giving the appearance of energy flowing outward and dissipating into the surrounding silence.

statement: This sketch visualizes an abstract data network as a dense tangle of dark cables with luminous streams flowing outward from a central point. The streams pulse rhythmically and branch at junctions in the cable network, creating a dynamic visualization that resembles energy dispersing through a complex system. The implementation uses a fixed number of streams that continuously regenerate, each following a spiral path outward while detecting collisions with cable junctions to trigger branching behavior. The visual effect emphasizes both the structured nature of the network and the chaotic flow of data through it, using color, motion, and branching patterns to represent the interaction between ordered infrastructure and dynamic information flow.
